facts.fact: The NSI table shows the 5-year Post Office Time Deposit at 7.5% from 01-01-2024 to 30-09-2026 (covering Jul-Sep 2026; columns 1/2/3/5 years: 6.90, 7.00, 7.10, 7.50)
India Post's savings page gives Time Deposit rates of 6.9% to 7.5% depending on the period
facts.quote: National Savings Time Deposit Account (TD) Rate of Interest: 6.9% to 7.5% Interest rates vary based on the period.
facts.note: The India Post page shows 'Last Updated On: 19.10.2026' (within Q3 FY 2026-27). The 7.5% top rate is the 5-year deposit per the NSI table.

facts.fact: Rates for 1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) were set by DEA's Office Memorandum dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: DEA's OM of 30.09.2026 keeps all small savings rates for Oct-Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) unchanged from Q2, so the 5-year Time Deposit stays at 7.5%
facts.note: Quoted from the OCR of the scanned OM. The 7.5% is derived: the OM keeps Q2 rates, and NSI shows the 5-year TD at 7.5% to 30.09.2026.
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter

summary: 5-year TD 7.5% confirmed on NSI (to 30-09-2026) and consistent with India Post's current 6.9%-7.5% range; DEA Q3 OM dated 30.09.2026 confirmed; 'unchanged' only in the scanned OM (manual).
